title: Hold a debt collector's licence
what: Hold a debt collector's licence before carrying on the business or functions of a debt collector.

sources.title: Debt Collectors Licensing Act 1964 (WA)
sources.quote: (c) in any way hold himself out to the public as ready to exercise or carry on, the business or any of the functions of a debt collector, unless he is the holder of a licence under this Act
